titleEn: Gaṃ is Gaṇeśa's own sound. The mantra is: Oṃ, gaṃ, to Gaṇapati — a bow.
meaningEn: Oṃ. Gaṃ — Gaṇeśa's own seed-sound, the first sound of his name with a hum. To Gaṇapati, the lord of Śiva's hosts, a bow. Four words: the opening syllable, the seed, the name, and the bow — and that is the pattern most seed-mantras follow.
meaningHi: ॐ। गं — गणेश जी की अपनी आवाज़, उनके नाम की पहली आवाज़ और एक गूँज। गणों के मालिक गणपति को प्रणाम। चार शब्द: ॐ, बीज, नाम, और नमः — और यही साँचा ज़्यादातर बीज-मंत्रों में है।
sayItLike: Om gum ga-na-pa-ta-ye na-mah — 'gum' short, like 'gun' ending in a hum

words.glossEn: Gaṇeśa's seed — ga, his first sound, with a hum
words.glossHi: गणेश का बीज — ग, उनकी पहली आवाज़, गूँज के साथ
words.root: ga (of Gaṇa) + a + anusvāra — built out loud in Gaṇapati Atharvaśīrṣa §8

words.glossEn: to Gaṇapati — the lord of the gaṇas, Śiva's hosts
words.grammar: to Gaṇapati — dative, hence -aye (an -i name takes -aye for 'to')
the closing word; 'a bow' to whoever is named in the dative

source.text: Gaṇapati Atharvaśīrṣa §8 (the seed gaṃ); Mantra-mahodadhi, Gaṇeśa taraṅga (the full mantra)
source.ref: Atharvaśīrṣa §8: ga-kāra + a-kāra + anusvāra + bindu + nāda = the Gaṇeśa-vidyā; Mantra-mahodadhi (Mahīdhara, 1588) for oṃ gaṃ gaṇapataye namaḥ
source.note: The Atharvaśīrṣa is a late Upaniṣad (c. 16th–17th c.); it builds the seed gaṃ and stops there. The full four-word mantra is the handbook (paddhati) form found in the Mantra-mahodadhi.

significance.textSays: Gaṇapati Atharvaśīrṣa §8 builds the seed in front of you: 'the letter ga is the first form, a the middle, the anusvāra the last; the dot above, the nāda joining — this is the Gaṇeśa-vidyā.'
significance.traditionSays: Said before any beginning — a journey, a wedding, a new ledger; Gaṇeśa is worshipped first by custom. 108 times on a mālā.
significance.weDoNotClaim: That saying it removes obstacles. Tradition asks Gaṇeśa; the outcome is not ours to promise.

practice.timeOfDay: morning, or before starting anything new; Thursday's mantra in this app
